findings.finding: Canonical online anchor caches lack explicit context_x; accepting their ambiguous x directly would weaken the GT isolation contract.
findings.action: Use the verified inputs/anchor_conditions/dev export. Future panels require the same explicit exporter and provenance checks. Keep strict reader rejection of ambiguous joint x.
findings.remaining_caution: Packed strong-context online_train still names its online anchor x; density_train separately carries explicit context_x. Do not feed joint supervised x to the online predictor.

findings.finding: Full-trace CFM continuous-density NFE32/64 agreement exceeds frozen .05nat tolerance on 3 of 4 exposed DEV parents.
findings.action: Keep CFM log density numerical/unqualified; do not use it as exact proposal density, exact MH correction, or passed calibrated density.

findings.finding: log_mean_unnormalized_weight estimates the integral of exp(-Phi-.5||x||²), not normalized Bayesian evidence.
findings.action: Retain unnormalized label. If evidence is ever reported, include Gaussian prior constant33log(2pi) and the normalized likelihood constant.

findings.finding: Paid audit explicit-density declaration is validated by finite sealed log_q_x, without an independent producer-kind whitelist.
findings.action: Optionally whitelist algebraic Gaussian/spline/triangular source kinds at freeze. Present producer never exports CFM log_q_x, so current CFM declaration fails closed.

findings.finding: Randomized inclusive marginal rank coverage is not simultaneous material credible-band coverage; pointwise moment heads are not joint spatial posterior laws.
findings.action: Preserve separate empirical interval/rank labels; report ROI and fixed projections, PSD correction magnitude, and absence of cross-pixel law.

findings.finding: Default first16 triangular block, global TRAIN Fisher frame, per-y GN coordinates, and GN random-alignment coordinates are distinct controls, with distinct data panels.
